definition: AWS RDS Basics is a core concept in AWS Solutions Architect. It refers to the techniques, principles and practices that let a practitioner work effectively with this topic in real systems.

theory.heading: What AWS RDS Basics is
theory.body: AWS RDS Basics describes the methods and patterns used within AWS Solutions Architect to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.
points: AWS RDS Basics is a named, repeatable concept.
It has a clear purpose and scope.
It connects to other course topics.

theory.heading: Why AWS RDS Basics matters
theory.body: Without AWS RDS Basics, systems built with AWS Solutions Architect are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How AWS RDS Basics works
theory.body: The mechanism behind AWS RDS Basics follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.
points: Apply the core principle of AWS RDS Basics.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of AWS RDS Basics
theory.body: AWS RDS Basics offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
points: Limitations: added overhead, not always needed.
